correctness.rationale: For two equal pre-synchronized groups in a complete loopless graph, strict majority of 2m−1 neighbors nominally flashing is equivalent to the other cluster flashing, yielding the exact pair map F_Cw. On the diagonal, the clock skips its entry phase once per cycle giving primitive C−1. For differences w≤d≤C−w there is no trigger and each neutral difference gives one C-cycle, J=max(0,C−2w+1). In overlap, entry triggers alternate on waves indexed C−w+2≤k≤w−1, giving K=max(0,2w−C−2) primitive C−1 cycles, each with exactly two indegree-zero predecessors, so basin size C+1. Other differences move toward synchrony and no other cycles remain. Synchrony basin B=C²−CJ−(C+1)K. Independent exhaustive functional graph traversals verified every state and basin for all 4≤C≤25, 1≤w<C, including nonmonotone C=10 fractions 50/100,1,34/100.
